title: Autumn Pumpkin

steps.heading: Get ready
paragraphs: Cover your table. Start with the preprinted pumpkin canvas. Keep the background white.
Use thin coats. Rinse your brush and pat it dry when you change colors.
steps.remainWhite: Pumpkin, stem, eyes, nose, mouth and background

steps.heading: Paint the pumpkin
paragraphs: Use orange for every pumpkin section. Paint around the eyes, nose and mouth.
Paint both teeth orange. Leave the stem and face openings white. Let the paint dry.
steps.remainWhite: Stem, eyes, nose, mouth and background

steps.heading: Paint the stem
paragraphs: Use olive green for the stem. Follow its bend with your brush.
Use a small brush near the black lines. Let the stem dry.

steps.heading: Finish the face
paragraphs: Use black for both eyes, the nose and the mouth. Paint carefully around the orange teeth.
Check the edges, then lay the canvas flat to dry.

care: Use thin coats. Rinse your brush and pat it dry when you change colors. Let each color dry before painting beside it.
cleanup: Lay your canvas flat to dry. Wash your brushes and close the paint pots.
sourceNotes: The four panels retain original stages 1-4 and stop at the first complete, recognizable jack-o'-lantern. The artwork uses the canonical region and line masks with flat ready-to-use colors. Mixing, groove shadows, painted texture and highlights from original stages 5-8 are omitted. The approved centered composition and square-to-portrait placement are unchanged. Instruction pictures retain dark teaching linework; the production transfer is the byte-identical approved gray SVG.
